purpose: Publish explicit owner-requested fix for main photo carousel counts: show licensed exact-species external diagnostic photos in same swipe gallery, distinguish from physically installed JPEGs
implementation: Presentation-only galleryImagesFor joins existing physical image records to exact-species, Creative Commons licensed, credited Wikimedia Commons references. Original manifest image counts and existing image index anchors stay unchanged. No other taxa affected without an explicit gallery_external_refs list.
photo_policy: Rights-filtered public site only. Third-party look-alike photos remain exclusively within comparisons. Every external item retains Commons source, creator, license and license URL; originals unmodified.

cache_refresh.reason: Prevent stale PWA learner from continuing to show 3/5 after source update
